response.sql:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM telescope_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
  FROM shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_average
FROM scored
WHERE share > share - share_minus_average
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Average share is the unweighted mean across all observatory stations, including stations with zero telescopes; stations with no telescopes therefore have share zero.
